sentences.text: Cosmacanthus was a member of the class Placodermi, a group of armored fish that belongs to the parent group Arthrodira.
This extinct genus is part of the family Groenlandaspididae.
Louis Agassiz named the genus in 1845.
Scientists have recorded five fossil occurrences of this animal in the Paleobiology Database.
The genus includes several species such as C. bullatus, C. carinatus, C. malcolmsoni, C. marginalis, C. priscus, C. sellatus, and C. semistriatus.
These fish lived between 382.31 and 372.15 million years ago during the Frasnian stage.
Their range included Ireland, the UK, Russia, and North America.
